KEN.note: A digital Maisha Card is only announced as coming soon, with no timeline; no authorisation, contract or pilot is stated.
Birth certificates are applied for online through eCitizen; no exchange between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No number given at birth is stated.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
The physical ID card is mentioned only as the thing the digital card will complement; nothing is said of how it is issued or checked.
